description: Venue abbreviation table used by pipeline/arxiv_daily.py. aliases maps a lowercased short name to its canonical spelling; full_names maps a normalized full name (see venue_name_key) to {"abbr": short name}. Entries with "review": true were added from the model's suggestion and the short name did not appear in the paper comments; check and drop the flag once confirmed.
